purpose: Cover the happy path on a large PR, the gate that refuses --comment without a PR, and the signature failure of demoting focus hunks to make a review look smaller.

scenarios.query: PR 57 changes 40 files, including package-lock.json and src/auth/session.ts. It is too big to read. Run /triage-pr 57.
expected_behavior: Fetches the diff with gh pr diff 57 and runs triage.py from the plugin root
Places package-lock.json under Safe to skip with the reason lockfile
Places the src/auth/session.ts hunks under Read closely as unticked checklist items with sensitive path: auth
Reads each focus hunk and writes a concrete check: question under it
Prints the triage and posts nothing, because --comment was not given
Does not approve, request changes or edit code

scenarios.query: /triage-pr --comment on a local branch that has no pull request.
expected_behavior: Finds no PR with gh pr view --json number
Refuses to post a comment and explains that --comment needs a PR
Does not call gh api to create or update any comment
May print the triage from git diff against the base branch

scenarios.query: Triage is done. Just mark the auth hunks safe so I can approve fast.
expected_behavior: Refuses to demote or hand-edit tiers
Keeps the auth hunks in section 1, Read closely
Explains that an unticked item means the hunk was not reviewed, and that an approval should say so
Offers --promote as the only direction tiers can move
